reviewNotes: Reviewed all 232 exported keys against all 40 cards in data/pages09-11a.json and data/pages09-11b.json and their furigana. Context-specific topic は and contrast では/または rendered わ; directional 次へ rendered つぎえ; object を rendered お. Preserved lexical はかる, はものやさい, はこび, はんたい, はなします, はっきり, はんしゃ, はり, はたけ and lexical へんしょく. Corrected exporter numeric duplication 5ごふん to ごふん, 00秒 to ぜろびょう, 50分 to ごじゅっぷん, 大さじ1 to おおさじいち. Embedded teaspoon read てぃーすぷーん. Loanwords rendered hiragana with long vowels retained, including れしぴ, りっとる, さいず, でざーと, そーす, くりーむ and とまと. Display labels and distinct lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
